courses.title: System Design for Senior Engineers
courses.description: By the end of System Design for Senior Engineers, you'll be able to apply system design confidently in Senior Software Engineer work, with a working sense of where mentoring engineers fits alongside it. The course moves from core system design technique through a few applied exercises, with a lighter look at mentoring engineers woven in throughout.
learning_outcomes: Applying system design to a real Senior Software Engineer scenario
Practicing system design through guided exercises
Getting a working introduction to mentoring engineers
Reviewing common mistakes and how to avoid them

courses.title: Technical Leadership in Practice
courses.description: Technical Leadership in Practice is a focused course on technical leadership for people already working toward a Senior Software Engineer role who want to go further. You'll work through applied exercises that push past the basics and into more realistic scenarios, with less hand-holding than an introductory course. By the end, you should feel noticeably more confident applying technical leadership on your own.
learning_outcomes: Applying technical leadership to a real Senior Software Engineer scenario
Practicing technical leadership through guided exercises
Building a short technical leadership exercise from scratch
Reviewing common mistakes and how to avoid them

courses.title: Performance Tuning Fundamentals
courses.description: Performance Tuning Fundamentals walks you through the basics of performance tuning, built for people new to Senior Software Engineer work. Starting from the essential vocabulary, you'll work through a handful of guided exercises that build a working sense of performance tuning, with no prior experience assumed. Expect short, practical lessons rather than a long project, with just enough depth to get you started.

alternates.title: System Design Essentials
alternates.description: System Design Essentials is a short introduction to system design for people moving toward a Senior Software Engineer role. You'll walk through the essential vocabulary and a few guided exercises that show system design in context, with no prior experience assumed. The pace is gentle, with short lessons rather than a heavy project. It's a reasonable starting point if system design is new to you.
learning_outcomes: Applying system design to a real Senior Software Engineer scenario
Practicing system design through guided exercises
Building a short system design exercise from scratch
Reviewing common mistakes and how to avoid them
